card.title: Rescue Me by Needing Me
card.instruction: Take protective control, then let each consequence reveal how much your confidence depends on remaining necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me fix your bike before you ride. I know which bolts matter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll check the checking. There must be something left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can just come riding with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Without a repair to do? Give me a minute to remember how.

mechanism: A takes protective repair control, then loses confidence when B offers companionship without needing repairs.
confusable: Unlike mere overhelping, consequences must expose dependence on being necessary.
comparison: S232-a admits difficulty simply riding together; S232-b asks for an avoidable menu-reading need.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
